annotations.title: Search the web and read the top results as Markdown

description: Web search for AI agents and RAG: runs each query, opens the top results and returns their main content as clean Markdown with title, URL and word count, ready to put in a prompt. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/rag-web-search on your Apify account (about $0.001 per page; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

queries.description: Search words or questions, e.g. ["how does retrieval augmented generation work"].

results_per_query.description: Top results to read per query.

name: search_web_for_rag

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search the web and read the top results as Markdown
